description:
Legend has it that whenever evil has appeared, a hero named Link has arisen to defeat it. The legend continues on
the surface of a vast and mysterious sea as Link sets sail in his most epic, awe-inspiring adventure yet. Aided by a
magical conductor's baton called the Wind Waker, he will face unimaginable monsters, explore puzzling dungeons, and
meet a cast of unforgettable characters as he searches for his kidnapped sister.

v1.0.0-beta.description:
# **THE WIND WAKER HD: Stable Release**

## How does this work?
For this APWorld you will need to have a decrypted US dump of TWWHD that you can acquire from a Wii U, and either the disk version or the eshop version of the game. The decrypted game consists of a folder with 3 subfolders (code, content, and meta). It is *not* a single file like an `.iso` or a `.wad`. You can dump a disc or digital install from your Wii U with [dumpling](https://cemu.cfw.guide/using-dumpling.html). 
It is also important to note this currently only supports Cemu, although plans are to support real Wii U hardware in the future.

## Links
- [Setup guide](https://github.com/Teotia444/twwhd-apworld/blob/main/docs/setup_en.md) (this contains essentially everything you need to play this)
- [APWorld Repo](https://github.com/Teotia444/twwhd-apworld)
- [Generator](https://github.com/Teotia444/TWWHD-Randomizer-expbuilds/tree/archipelago) (latest versions can be found in the Actions tab or using [the nightly link](https://nightly.link/Teotia444/TWWHD-Randomizer-expbuilds/workflows/build_latest/archipelago?preview), refer to the setup guide)
- Tracker: The generator comes with a tracker tab that is able to connect to an AP server. Note that the tracker might still have issues, but those won't affect your multiworld obviously

## Notes
- There are currently no plans to port this to another region like EU. This change would have to come from upstream.
- The expensive beedle checks seem to occasionally not send. Exclude them if you don't want to take risks until they are figured out.

## Bug report
If you come across an issue during your multiworld, it would be appreciated to report it here so that it can be fixed asap. When reporting an issue, it is appreciated if you can provide the APTWWHD file used for the multiworld, as well as the version hash that appears in the name of the generator window (Wind Waker HD Randomizer XXXXXXX, with the XXXXXXX being your version hash).

v1.0.1-beta.description:
# Changes: 
Fixed the following logic mishaps : 
- Windfall Island - Potion Shop 15 Green/Blue Chu
- Dragon Roost Cavern - Water Jug On Upper Shelf
- Earth Temple - Chest Behind Destructable Wall

For this release, you will *not* need to update the generator.

v1.0.2-beta.description:
# Changes
Fixed the following locations :
- `Windfall Island - Lenzo Bring Forest Firefly` will temporarily be disabled as it's a repeatable check and is not tied to a flag
- `Windfall Island - Lenzo Become Assistant` used to not register, that's fixed

Tracker: 
- Added a password field to the tracker so you can connect to password locked servers
- Removed the mail chaining logic which would display available mail on certain conditions even if it was impossible
- Restored the location list background which was removed for unknown reasons (upstream??)

Others :
- fixed generation with blue chu being held back by a typo
- fixed death link sending twice sometimes when it was triggered by another player

(this update comes with a generator update)
